```{r}
#| eval: false
# This chunk generates paper_changes_V1_to_V2.pdf via latexdiff

root <- normalizePath("C:/cloud/research/fama_1970", winslash = "/")

paper_v1 <- file.path(root, "paper_V1.qmd")
paper_v2 <- file.path(root, "paper_V2.qmd")

tex_v1 <- file.path(root, "paper_V1.tex")
tex_v2 <- file.path(root, "paper_V2.tex")
tex_diff <- file.path(root, "paper_changes_V1_to_V2.tex")
pdf_diff <- file.path(root, "paper_changes_V1_to_V2.pdf")

# 1) Render to LaTeX in the same folder
system2("quarto", c("render", paper_v1, "--to", "latex", "--output", "paper_V1.tex", "--output-dir", root))
system2("quarto", c("render", paper_v2, "--to", "latex", "--output", "paper_V2.tex", "--output-dir", root))

# 2) latexdiff -> UTF-8 output
# Write to a temp file to avoid Windows encoding issues

tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".tex")
system2("latexdiff", c("--flatten", tex_v1, tex_v2), stdout = tmp)

# Ensure UTF-8 without BOM
lines <- readLines(tmp, encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines(lines, tex_diff, useBytes = TRUE)

# 3) Compile with xelatex via latexmk
system2("latexmk", c(
  "-xelatex",
  "-interaction=nonstopmode",
  "-file-line-error",
  paste0("-output-directory=", root),
  tex_diff
))

message("Done: ", pdf_diff)

# 4) Clean latexmk auxiliary files (needs tex_diff present)
system2("latexmk", c(
  "-c",
  paste0("-output-directory=", root),
  tex_diff
))

# 5) Clean up intermediate files
to_remove <- c(tex_v1, tex_v2, tex_diff, tmp)
to_remove <- to_remove[file.exists(to_remove)]
if (length(to_remove) > 0) {
  file.remove(to_remove)
}
```
